title: RAW UNREVIEWED: host tree and attached parasite receive separate names
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Seek a dated primary that explicitly names a host tree and a biologically distinct attached parasitic plant on it, with the relation written in the same entry. A genuinely admitted botanical target would need visible ownership of both organisms and separate complete-group text loci before comparing host, parasite and graft rivals. Generic branching shape cannot establish either identity.
